title: Supervised Source Separation of Electric Vehicle Interior Noise Using a Hybrid Transformer Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2610.32310v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The interior sound of an electric vehicle is a superposition of several distinct noise contributions - wind noise, tire noise, powertrain (electric drive unit and inverter) noise, and auxiliary-drive noise - whose relative balance governs both the overall loudness and the perceived sound quality in the vehicle interior. Decomposing a recorded vehicle interior signal into these source contributions is a prerequisite for targeted acoustic engineering, but requires effortful measurement campaigns as well as expertise in the field of transfer path analysis. This work formulates the decomposition as a supervised, binaural source-separation problem with four target source contributions and adapts a hybrid time-spectrogram transformer architecture, originally developed for music demixing, to the domain of sound source separation for technical systems. translated_title: 使用混合Transformer架构的电动汽车车内噪声监督式源分离
translated_abstract: 电动汽车的车内声音是多种不同噪声贡献的叠加——包括风噪、轮胎噪声、动力总成（电驱动单元和逆变器）噪声以及辅助驱动噪声——这些成分的相对平衡决定了车内的整体响度和感知声品质。将录制的车内信号分解为这些声源贡献是开展针对性声学工程的前提，但这需要耗费大量精力的测量工作以及传递路径分析领域的专业知识。本工作将这一分解问题形式化为一个包含四个目标声源贡献的监督式双耳声源分离问题，并将最初为音乐分离开发的混合时-频谱Transformer架构适配到技术系统的声源分离领域。为消除声源贡献之间的歧义，引入了以运行状态为形式的条件输入机制……
tldr: 本文将原本用于音乐分离的混合时-频谱Transformer架构适配到电动汽车领域，提出一种监督式双耳源分离方法，可将车内噪声分解为风噪、胎噪、动力总成噪声和辅助驱动噪声四种成分，从而无需昂贵的测量和传递路径分析即可支持针对性声学工程。
en_tdlr: This work adapts a hybrid time-spectrogram transformer architecture, originally developed for music demixing, to supervised binaural source separation that decomposes electric vehicle interior noise into wind, tire, powertrain, and auxiliary-drive noise contributions, enabling targeted acoustic engineering without laborious measurement campaigns.
